jobs.title: 2027 Data, Digital and AI Graduate Program
jobs.description: As a graduate in Data, Digital and AI, you'll design, build and deploy intelligent data, digital and AI powered solutions to our customers and bankers; powering exceptional customer experiences and driving real change. As an AI Scientist graduate, you'll turn data into intelligence from day one – building, training and deploying machine learning, Gen-AI and agentic models that go live for real customers and colleagues. Over 12 months, you'll be embedded within business squads gaining hands-on experience from day one while shaping your own career direction. Halfway through, you'll have the opportunity move into a new squad within the Data, Digital and AI Division - broadening your experience and deepening your expertise. A solid understanding of core machine learning concepts · An interest in generative AI and large language models, with an understanding of responsible AI are required.

jobs.title: Services Australia 2027 National Graduate Program - Data stream
jobs.description: As a data graduate, you'll contribute to data-driven projects that support policy, improve services and inform decision-making across the agency. To be eligible, you must have completed at least an Australian Qualifications Framework Level 7 qualification (a Bachelor degree), or higher equivalent by 31 December 2026, and have completed your most recent eligible qualification between 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2026. Additionally, you must be an Australian citizen at the time of application and be able to obtain and maintain a valid Australian Government security clearance if required.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Program - Technology and Data Advisory
jobs.description: As a Graduate Consultant in Technology and Data at KordaMentha, you will work on real data, risk, regulatory and transaction challenges from day one. You will help organisations make critical decisions using analytics and applied AI in live environments, not hypothetical case studies or internal projects. You will design, build and explain data-driven solutions that are used in regulatory responses, risk remediation programs and major commercial decisions across the Australian market.

jobs.title: AI / Machine Learning Graduate
jobs.description: Commencing February 2027, you'll join a structured two year Graduate Program with rotations, mentoring support and clear career pathways beyond the program. You'll have a dedicated buddy to guide your onboarding, along with experienced mentors who support your development and career decisions throughout the program. Opportunities are available across AI and Machine Learning, Technology and AI Risk, Business Improvement (AI), and AI Engineering for Digital Operations. AI-aligned roles support the skills and technology needed to operate a smarter, more resilient network as the energy system evolves.

jobs.title: 2027 Technology & Operations Graduate Program
jobs.description: working across multiple areas including technical and non-technical functions, with opportunities to collaborate across risk, strategy and planning, property, capability, operations, IT helpdesk, data and technology, plus software engineering and architecture. You'll be involved in thought leadership decisions to drive and deliver the IAG Technology strategy, support your people to evolve resilient, scalable technology that can meet changing customer and business needs. The Technology & Operations team are champions for GenAI, testing, building and adopting various tools to transform how they work and improve customer experiences. Commencing on 8 February 2027.

jobs.title: NLP算法工程师【2026届春招】
jobs.description: 负责前沿的检索增强生成（RAG）算法的研究与实现，持续优化包括多路召回、混合排序、信息抽取在内的核心技术链路。主导游戏知识库的数据挖掘工作，深入研究并实践针对海量游戏文本（如设计文档、剧情、玩家评论）的特征提取、实体链接、关系抽取等知识挖掘技术。探索并应用知识图谱等技术，将挖掘出的结构化知识进行有效组织，构建一个覆盖数十万游戏实体的、可扩展、高质量的知识库。Computer science or related major, master's degree or higher preferred, with solid foundation in mathematics and computer science. Excellent Python programming ability with strict code quality standards.

jobs.title: 模型算法工程师
jobs.company: 戴盟（深圳）机器人科技有限公司
jobs.description: 负责具身智能模型的工程实现、训练系统、评测流程和真机部署，重点将研究算法转化为稳定、可复现、可迭代、可交付的模型能力。包括具身智能模型的工程化开发、搭建训练pipeline、将算法方案转化为工程代码、模型评测与版本管理、处理机器人多模态数据、完成真实机器人平台上的部署调试等。任职要求：计算机、机器人、自动化、人工智能等相关专业本科及以上学历；熟练掌握Python和PyTorch；熟悉Linux开发环境；具有模型训练、数据处理等相关经验；理解imitation learning、diffusion policy等基本概念
